hebrewText: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְּ/ךָ֥ שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם אֲבֹתֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/קָם֩ הָ/עָ֨ם הַ/זֶּ֜ה וְ/זָנָ֣ה אַחֲרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵֽכַר הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא בָא שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ בְּ/קִרְבּ֔/וֹ וַ/עֲזָבַ֕/נִי וְ/הֵפֵר֙ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אִתּֽ/וֹ

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: Mosheh, the Israelite lawgiver
tokens.kjv: Moses.

tokens.bdb: lo!
tokens.kjv: behold, lo, see.

tokens.bdb: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.

tokens.bdb: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
tokens.kjv: accompanying, against, and, as ([idiom] long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).

tokens.bdb: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
tokens.kjv: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

tokens.bdb: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
tokens.kjv: abide, accomplish, [idiom] be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, [idiom] be dim, endure, [idiom] enemy, enjoin, get up, make good, help, hold, (help to) lift up (again), make, [idiom] but newly, ordain, perform, pitch, raise (up), rear (up), remain, (a-) rise (up) (again, against), rouse up, set (up), (e-) stablish, (make to) stand (up), stir up, strengthen, succeed, (as-, make) sure(-ly), (be) up(-hold, -rising).

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.kjv: folk, men, nation, people.

tokens.bdb: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
tokens.kjv: he, [idiom] hence, [idiom] here, it(-self), [idiom] now, [idiom] of him, the one...the other, [idiom] than the other, ([idiom] out of) the (self) same, such (a one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side...on that side, [idiom] thus, very, which. Compare H2063 (זֹאת), H2090 (זֹה), H2097 (זוֹ), H2098 (זוּ).

tokens.bdb: to commit adultery (usually of the female, and less often of simple fornication, rarely of involuntary ravishment); figuratively, to commit idolatry (the Jewish people being regarded as the spouse of Jehovah)
tokens.kjv: (cause to) commit fornication, [idiom] continually, [idiom] great, (be an, play the) harlot, (cause to be, play the) whore, (commit, fall to) whoredom, (cause to) go a-whoring, whorish.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to commit adultery (usually of the female
tokens.enLiteralWord: to commit adultery (usually of the female
tokens.explanation: to commit adultery (usually of the female
tokens.explanationEn: to commit adultery (usually of the female

tokens.bdb: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom
tokens.kjv: alien, strange ([phrase] -er).

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

tokens.bdb: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
tokens.kjv: in it, [phrase] thence, there (-in, [phrase] of, [phrase] out), [phrase] thither, [phrase] whither.

tokens.bdb: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] among, [idiom] before, bowels, [idiom] unto charge, [phrase] eat (up), [idiom] heart, [idiom] him, [idiom] in, inward ([idiom] -ly, part, -s, thought), midst, [phrase] out of, purtenance, [idiom] therein, [idiom] through, [idiom] within self.

tokens.bdb: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
tokens.kjv: commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: to break up (usually figuratively), i.e. to violate, frustrate
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any ways, break (asunder), cast off, cause to cease, [idiom] clean, defeat, disannul, disappoint, dissolve, divide, make of none effect, fail, frustrate, bring (come) to nought, [idiom] utterly, make void.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
tokens.kjv: confederacy, (con-) feder(-ate), covenant, league.

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

tokens.bdb: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
tokens.kjv: be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.

tokens.bdb: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.
